instruction: Write an XDP program that performs next-hop routing using a BPF hash map 'route_table'. Look up the IPv4 destination address. If a route exists, rewrite the Ethernet destination MAC to the next-hop MAC and return XDP_TX. Otherwise return XDP_PASS.
requirements: Define BPF hash map 'route_table' mapping IPv4 address (__u32) to MAC address (unsigned char [6])
Rewrite eth->h_dest and return XDP_TX on match
Check boundaries on Ethernet and IPv4 headers

tests.name: test_route_tx
tests.description: IPv4 packet destined for 10.0.19.1 should be routed with XDP_TX

tests.name: test_unrouted_pass
tests.description: IPv4 packet without route should pass with XDP_PASS

tests.name: test_arp_pass
tests.description: Non-IP ARP packet should pass with XDP_PASS

tests.name: test_truncated_pass
tests.description: Truncated Ethernet frame header should pass with XDP_PASS
